issue: São Paulo State Decree 63.853/2018 places the species in Annex I (regionally extinct or threatened), not Near Threatened as recorded by SALVE; the sub-category could not be read from the sources reached. No official Rio de Janeiro state list naming the species was found; the municipality of Rio de Janeiro lists it as Vulnerable (Resolution SMAC 073/2022).
action: Confirm the São Paulo sub-category in the decree's Annex I and the current Rio de Janeiro state act before citing state listings in the CMP.
source: SP Decree 63.853/2018; Resolution SMAC 073/2022; Ficha SALVE
resolution: SALVE-only entries removed from the status chart; São Paulo shown as threatened, category not confirmed; Rio de Janeiro state shown as no official listing found.

issue: No national red-list category was found for Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama or Suriname. Venezuela's 1999 (NT) and 2008 (VU) categories come from WikiEVA, a secondary source; the 2015 category (VU, A4cde) is from the Libro Rojo itself.
action: Ask range-state contacts whether national assessments exist (e.g. Panama's list under Resolution DM-0657-2016) and confirm the earlier Venezuelan editions.
resolution: Shown in the status chart as 'No national category found'; Venezuelan sources named in the tooltips.

issue: The IUCN assessment lists Guyana and Trinidad and Tobago within the range, and Guyana falls within management unit FRGU, but neither appears in the range-state table.
action: Decide whether to add Guyana (and Trinidad and Tobago) to the CMP's range-state list.
source: IUCN Red List (Secchi et al. 2018); CMP 5.2
resolution: Range-state table and map shading follow the CMP list.

issue: Eleven IWC recommendation rows read 'Open CLOSED' in the source table.
action: Confirm the intended status in the IWC recommendations database.
resolution: Shown as Closed and noted as probably closed or superseded; open recommendations: 4.

issue: The Southern Brazil and Uruguay Coastal Ecosystems IMMA lists the species as supporting but lies mostly south of its range.
action: None; kept out by decision of the CMP coordinators.
resolution: 18 IMMAs shown with official boundaries, with IUCN MMPATF credit.

issue: The Bertozzi presentation concerns franciscana (Pontoporia blainvillei), not Sotalia.
action: Use only as methodological comparison (interview-based bycatch estimates versus strandings).
resolution: No franciscana figures are used as Guiana dolphin indicators.

issue: In the Overall Threat Scoring Form, category 2 was labelled 'Commercial & industrial areas', duplicating category 1; the IUCN scheme names category 2 'Agriculture & aquaculture'.
action: Apply the same changes to the scoring form itself.
resolution: Category 2 renamed 'Agriculture & aquaculture'; rows 1.1 and 1.2 merged as 'Urban and industrial areas' (23 rows).
